name: What We Should Not Eat
overview: Scripture reveals God's initial provision for mankind as plant-based food, granting every seed-bearing herb and fruit for sustenance (Genesis 1:29). After the Fall, eating from the trees of the garden was still permitted (Genesis 3:2), and post-Flood, God expanded dietary allowance to include every living moving thing (Genesis 9:3). However, the Mosaic Law later detailed distinctions between clean and unclean animals, explicitly forbidding consumption of creatures like the swine, which, despite having divided hooves, does not chew the cud and is therefore unclean (Leviticus 11:1,7). These instructions underscore God's holiness and the call for His people to live distinctively, even in their eating habits.
